en: A black-and-white photograph showing the interior of a bacteriological laboratory. The image features a woman in period clothing (early 20th century style) standing near laboratory equipment, including glassware, test tubes, and filtration apparatus. There are cabinets with bottles and laboratory tools, and a large window provides natural light with a view of a residential building outside. The bottom of the image is labeled 'Bacteriologisch Laboratorium.'
